predictors: same XGBoost and TabM architectures, configurations, seeds and train/tune/refit split as SCPL study; no Deep Lasso retraining needed
nuisance_fitting: on scoring sample B, as allowed by published empirical algorithm; B responses are used for response-conditioned nuisance estimation, never base prediction model training

ridge.tuning: none; fixed adapter, not original paper RidgeCV settings

quadratic: conditional mean basis: all input coordinates and elementwise squares; add response and response-square and response-times-each-other-feature on response-conditioned side
scale: Ridge prediction of log squared residual; same quadratic basis on both sides, response terms only on response-conditioned side; exp clipped to [.05,20] times scoring residual variance before square root
residual_sampling: one independent permutation per feature and side, shared across mechanisms; no bootstrap p-values
mean_score: ordinary row-average squared-loss difference, identical published algorithm aggregation; no seller-standardization
author_code_fix: utils.knockoff_threshold returns last finite mesh value if no candidate satisfies q; adapter returns infinity per paper Eq1; explicit counterexample retained, not claimed as innovation
real_sampling: same full reference, 30 complementary 50% seller pairs, 20 70%, 20 80%, 10 algorithm-seed-only cases
simulations: all 800 stored SCPL datasets, same input/response/truth hashes; 8 scenes x100; new method computations, not 800 new datasets
real_prediction: Top12 and Top8, common XGBoost and TabM, canonical sorted columns, identical sets share prediction cache
simulation_prediction: same canonical-column XGBoost as SCPL, Top12 and native q=.2; empty set uses mean
theory: oracle equality of conditional means and scales under the null gives exchangeable two-sided residual resampling; estimated nuisance models do not automatically inherit finite-sample control
novelty: conditional-moment adapter of the paper's two-sided conditional sampling idea; no priority claim
comparison: paired comparisons within each scene; primary candidate vs same-predictor ridge/quad/scale and existing SCPL/SHAP; no overall winner from selected scenes
stop_rule: finish registered cases regardless of whether results are favorable
